page.layout: One column of text, set in roman with italic and Greek-free content. Above the text, centred: the running head "DEDICATIO.". Below the last full line, at the right: the catchword "fieri". No page number and no signature are printed. The right edge of the scan cuts some lines.

main_text.p: ri postulet, vestrum tamen im primis ad hæc studium requi-rit: quos in hunc finem & pe-dem figere apud Antipodes, & cum alterius orbis populis in fœdus coire voluit. Quocirca vos CHRISTI nomine, cujus in hac re causam ago, rogatos velim; summâ diligentiâ, serio-que conatu, hac quæ ad vos defertur DEI gratiâ utamini. Varia enim vestra ad felicem hujus operis successum requi-runtur officia: præcipuè autem ut Lex Christianæ modestiæ in-ter milites & nautas vim ha-beat, ne offendiculo sint ijs, quos ex Infidelibus Evangeli-santium labor studet ad CHRI-STUM ducere. page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts several lines (for example "im", "requi", "pe-", "Antipodes,", "cujus", "gratiâ utamini"), so the endings of those lines may be incomplete on the scan. The text was copied from what is visible. Small capitals are given as full capitals (CHRISTI, DEI, CHRI-STUM). The faint show-through at the bottom left was left out.
